single_frame_evidence.signed_allowlist: 3406f1ca - only cam2/(134,128)/flexid0, ULP<=4 and beyond4=0, base frame only

current_state.gap: no multi-frame reference, no pose-change-to-render criterion, no multi-frame test entity

candidates.verdict: feasible but heavy for a first version

candidates.scheme: per-frame criteria (reuse signed) + cross-frame change-visibility assertion + product==reference per frame + two-run sha
candidates.cost: 3 frames ~14 MB, 1 capture window + 1 validation window

candidates.verdict: not for acceptance; possible negative control

recommended_design.frame_set: base + 2 clock steps with monotonic flex pose evolution
recommended_design.per_frame_criteria: same as the signed single-frame criteria (bit-first)
recommended_design.cross_frame_criteria: adjacent-frame depth/seg changed pixel count >= threshold (candidate 0.5% of that camera's pixels, awaiting user signature), product==reference bit-level on every frame, two-run sha equal
recommended_design.degenerate_guard: if adjacent reference frames are bit-identical the frame set is declared non-discriminating and the round fails (never passes)
recommended_design.fail_conditions: any frame out of bounds / insufficient changed pixels / two-run sha mismatch / non-discriminating reference -> round fails; stop, no retry, no relaxation
recommended_design.allowlist_not_inherited: 3406f1ca applies to the base frame only; new frames are bit-first, and a recurring same-pixel difference must be reported to the user instead of widening the allowance
user_signature_required: whether to do multi-frame at all
handling if a new frame reproduces the base 1-pixel difference

capture_plan.env: offline authoring, pinned venv, editable mujoco-warp 71da24d9, use_fast_math=false, same GPU; no PyPI wheel
capture_plan.script_extension: scripts/authoring/capture_render_flex.py gains a frame loop: step flex state a fixed number of times, record flexvert_xpos (host state.npz) plus upstream render reference (rgb/depth/seg) and camera poses per frame
capture_plan.size_estimate: single frame rgb 2.36 MB + depth 0.79 MB + seg 1.58 MB = 4.73 MB; 3 frames ~14 MB
capture_plan.determinism: capture twice, byte-identical; provenance records pin/recipe/GPU
